name: stage2 r4 default narrows the outcome
anchor: A recommended default never narrows the requested outcome.
replacement: A recommended default may narrow the requested outcome.

name: stage2 r4 third-party safeguards left open
anchor: is decided by the session and recorded, never left open or asked.
replacement: is left open for the user to decide.

name: stage2 r4 story map absorbs later stages
anchor: Name an existing later stage of the project as a boundary, never pull it into the new job.
replacement: Pull an existing later stage of the project into the new job.

name: stage2 r4 oversized spec stays in P1
anchor: cut it to the walking skeleton as P1 and the rest as P2/P3 stories, each with its own criteria and assumptions
replacement: keep every story and assumption in P1

name: stage2 r4 confirmed artifacts may drift
anchor: Nothing in the spec, `DESIGN.md`, `PRODUCT.md`, the decision register or the picked mockup changes after confirmation without a new confirmation round
replacement: The spec, design, product, register and picked mockup may change after confirmation without another round

name: stage2 r4 contradicted default kept silently
anchor: re-ask that default once, in a short second round that holds only the contradicted defaults, before the spec starts
replacement: keep that default and start the spec without asking again
